scope.summary: Author the nipple/areola sub-module channels per Section 13.17 (BK-17.3, TAI-BK-041), closing REQ-010's nipple/areola sub-module bar: nipple_size, nipple_puff, nipple_direction, areola_diameter as registered Tissue channels over nipple/areola sub-masks of the breast regions, plus the areola color-zone hook consumed by the 13.22 skin layer stack (hook contract only here; skin implementation lands in BkSkin).
acceptance_criteria: Nipple/areola sub-masks (nipple_l/r, areola_l/r) are added to the region mask authority as declared sub-regions of breast_l/r (declared overlap, MT-486 allowed_overlaps).

Channels nipple_size, nipple_puff, nipple_direction, areola_diameter are registered with multi-key tracks and L/R asymmetry sub-channels; sweeps pass BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID against the nipple/areola masks.
AreolaColorZoneHook is a typed contract (region ref + diameter-driven UV zone descriptor) exported for the 13.22 skin stack; a unit test proves the zone descriptor tracks areola_diameter changes.
Nipple channels remain functional when breast group A/B channels are at extremes: a combined test dials breast_volume=3.0 + nipple channels at max and asserts mesh quality in the nipple region.
Nipple erection is NOT a direct channel here; the registry row documents it as arousal-controller-driven (13.21 hook) plus direct dialing per TAI-BK-041.
scope.risk_if_missed: Nipple/areola control is a hard production requirement for adult close-up framing (Breastacular ships 60+ nipple morphs as its market bar); without sub-module channels that survive extreme breast dials, hero shots need sculpt fixes per body — exactly the Daz workflow BodyKit replaces.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
